items.title: Labor, Greens cut deal on CGT and negative gearing
items.description: The Greens pledge their support in exchange for an end to an exemption that allows self-managed super funds to borrow money to invest in residential property, and a delay on the overhaul of the NDIS.

items.title: 'Ridiculous and disrespectful' inquiry into NDIS cuts extended
items.description: Disability advocates welcome an extension to a Senate inquiry probing a bill paving the way for the biggest-ever cuts to the NDIS.

items.title: Australia approves restricted use of herbicide banned in 70 other countries
items.description: The Australian Pesticides and Veterinary Medicines Authority concludes its nearly 30-year review of the controversial but popular herbicide.

items.title: 'They've been caught out': KPMG fallout continues with resignations
items.description: KPMG chair Martin Sheppard and two audit partners are leaving the accounting and consulting giant in the wake of a scandal over misuse of confidential client information and the alleged mistreatment of a whistleblower.

items.title: Chihuahua Jet takes to the air as more pets allowed in cabin
items.description: An Australian airline is allowing small cats and dogs on a range of flights, with other passengers appearing unconcerned about sharing the plane with furry creatures.

items.title: 'We lost our son': India's medical exams scandal leads to tragedy and uproar
items.description: More than 2 million students across India have resat the country's highly competitive medical entrance exam after last month's test was cancelled amid allegations that questions had been leaked.

items.title: Who wins and who loses in the NSW budget
items.description: With billions for health but limited funds for the state's regions, here are the 2026 NSW budget's winners and losers.

items.title: The winners and losers in Queensland's state budget
items.description: The Queensland treasurer has handed down the state budget. Take a look at what it includes and who benefits.

items.title: Newly discovered spider uses 'ballista' web to capture prey
items.description: A bizarre species of spider from the rainforests of Far North Queensland springs a nasty surprise.

items.title: Dead birds to be tested for H5N1 bird flu after washing up on SA coast
items.description: Two dead seabirds have been collected and are being tested for the H5N1 bird flu virus in South Australia, following Australia's first confirmed cases of the deadly variant this week.

items.title: Women's team snubbed as new owner confirmed for Central Coast Mariners
items.description: A new owner has been confirmed for struggling A-League club the Central Coast Mariners, but it has only bought the men's team and the club's academy, leaving the future of the women's team in doubt.

items.title: Can Australia still make the knockout rounds of the World Cup?
items.description: The FIFA World Cup is well underway and it's starting to become clear which teams are progressing through to the next round of competition. But, Australia's fate still isn't sealed. Australia currently sitting second in its group with one win against Türkiye and one loss against the United States. We break down how the new qualifying process works, what's changed, and what the Socceroos need from their match on Friday against Paraguay.

items.title: Live: WiseTech executive chair Richard White denies human trafficking reports
items.description: WiseTech initially gained ground but is now in the red again after Monday's 18 per cent plunge. The ASX is seesawing between gains and losses. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Students protest AI amid growing national concerns
items.description: As Australia tracks toward becoming a global leader in artificial intelligence infrastructure, a group of high school students is demanding stronger regulation.

items.title: 'Look at us go!': First Nations actors celebrate Logies nods
items.description: With strong representation of Indigenous talent in this year's Logie Award nominations, actor Lila McGuire says it's a "very important time" and "a gift for young mob seeing so many of us excelling".

items.title: 'Like looking into a mirror': I met my siblings at the age of 35
items.description: Cheryl van Wageningen was shocked to receive a letter revealing that not only was she Indigenous, but she had a brother and a sister.

items.title: You won't see Hugh Jackman the same after The Death of Robin Hood
items.description: Plus Toy Story 5 trots out the same old games, Australian horror scores another winner and Colony uses zombies to ring the warning bell about AI.

items.title: Quick hits: Wild weather, Messi magic and Merlin meets the president
items.description: Some wild weather brings the World Cup to a standstill, but not before Lionel Messi lights it up to rewrite the record books. Here are today's quick hits.

items.title: Photo gives clues to missing man's final hours before disappearance
items.description: A previously unreleased image answers one question in the case of missing Queensland man Jack McLennan, but many others remain.

items.title: Church youth leader sentenced for sexually assaulting 13-year-old
items.description: A man who assaulted a girl in his car has dodged a lengthy jail term, with a judge saying there were "exceptional circumstances" that warranted a discounted sentence.

items.title: Perfect dupes of ABC articles are fuelling an industrial-scale scam
items.description: A $350 million scam is targeting Australians using AI-generated images of ABC journalists and politicians.

items.title: Award-winning artwork revealed as 'blatant copy'
items.description: The Doyles award committee is investigating why it took nearly 12 months to discover a winning landscape painting was an imitation of another artist's work.

items.title: Nose landing gear failure could have caused fatal plane crash, ATSB says
items.description: A plane crash that killed two people and injured several others in Adelaide earlier this year could have been caused by a failure in the plane's nose landing gear, an ongoing investigation has found.

items.title: Ex-Wimbledon champ handed four-year suspension for refusing doping test
items.description: Markéta Vondroušová, who lifted the Wimbledon trophy in 2023, is given a "significant ban" by the International Tennis Integrity Agency.

items.title: Qatar gas complex explosion leaves at least 13 people dead
items.description: The Sunday night blast in Qatar's Ras Laffan gas processing facility is one of the deadliest events recorded in gas industry.
